ar.meaning: تَتَبَّعَ مَوْقِعَ الكَوْكَبِ أَوِ النَّجْمِ بِآلَةِ الرُّؤْيَةِ لِتَحْدِيدِ سَمْتِهِ

de.meaning: die Höhe eines Gestirns mittels Alhidade und Visier genau anvisieren

en.meaning: to sight celestial coordinates using an alidade and pinhole sights

conjugation_examples.ar: يَرْصُدُ المُرَتِّبُ مَيْلَ الشَّمْسِ لِتَحْدِيدِ أَذَانِ الظُّهْرِ.
conjugation_examples.de: Der Zeitmesser peilt den Sonnenstand zur Feststellung des Mittagsgebets.
conjugation_examples.en: The timekeeper sights the solar altitude to determine the midday call to prayer.

conjugation_examples.ar: رَصَدَ العُلَمَاءُ حَرَكَةَ الكَوَاكِبِ مِنْ أَعْلَى المَنَارَةِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ صَافِيَةٍ.
conjugation_examples.de: Die Gelehrten beobachteten die Planetenbahnen von der Turmhöhe in klarer Nacht.
conjugation_examples.en: The scholars observed the planetary motions from atop the tower on a clear night.
